dataLocation.evidence: Plugin source: video URLs saved as product post meta _nickx_video_text_url on product save; settings in wp_options; videos are links to self-hosted files or YouTube/Vimeo, no vendor account or sync service.

pitfalls.summary: Video URLs (an array per product, YouTube/Vimeo/self-hosted) are read by lib/product-video-extract.js from resources/product-video-sources.json and land as product media videos; links Wix cannot hold become product-video-manual cutover items. VERIFIED IN PLUGIN SOURCE (admin/class-video-field.php): keys _nickx_video_text_url, _nickx_product_video_type, _nickx_product_video_thumb_ids, _custom_thumbnail.

quirks: The plugin writes `[""]` to _nickx_video_text_url on every product save, so the key is present on products with no video. Presence is decided by non-empty values, never by the key (seen on a live store: 382 products, all empty).
